title: Cherrypicking Protocol for High-Throughput Workflows
author: Opentrons
materials: Create your CSV file according to our instructions.

steps.title: Create correctly formatted CSV
steps.instruction: Prepare a comma‑separated (.csv) file that includes a header line and the following columns in this exact order: New Tip, Source Labware, Source Slot, Source Well, Source Aspiration Height Above Bottom (mm), Dest Labware, Dest Slot, Dest Well, Dest Dispense Height Above Bottom (mm), Volume (µL). Specify each labware’s loadname and deck slot; all volumes must be expressed in microliters. The CSV will be read by the OT‑2 Run App to load labware automatically, fill empty slots with the required tipracks, and prompt you to refill tipracks if they run out during the run.

substeps.instruction: Include a header row as shown above.
Enter values for each column for every transfer.
Save the file with a .csv extension.

steps.title: Upload CSV and set parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App (version 3.15.0 or later), upload the prepared CSV file and select all desired settings according to the “Setup” section to customize the cherrypicking protocol.

steps.title: Download generated OT‑2 protocol
steps.instruction: Click the blue “Download” button located above the deck map to save the customized OT‑2 Python protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Load protocol into Opentrons App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons App, upload the downloaded protocol file, and follow the on‑screen instructions to arrange the deck, calibrate your labware, and prepare to run the protocol.

steps.title: Add samples to source plate
steps.instruction: Place the source plate containing the samples you want to pick onto the deck slot specified in the CSV before starting the robot run.
